_meta.method: Each probe's twoway command (plus the option under test, if any) is exported to SVG and read through scripts/svg_truth.py; added_texts/removed_texts are the probe's <text> elements minus its control probe's, by multiset (collections.Counter), kept in the probe's own document order; added_fills is a set difference of svg_fills() colours.
